item.title: Version 1.24.0
item.description:
### New
- Image clips — add images as video clips for static overlays, outros, and more - Keyboard press rendering — display key presses on screen during playback - Cursor type detection — shows the correct macOS cursor (pointer, grab hand, text selector, etc.) - Auto-hide cursor — cursor fades out when stationary for a period - Glass border style
### Improved
- Major export speed improvements with parallel frame processing and improved caching - Zoom now applies only to video and shadow layers, keeping backgrounds static - Refreshed UI with more colour and updated controls - Migrated to Polar for license key management
### Fixed
- Fixed render parallelisation lock issue
